set.request: Integrate LayoutTool into the devbar to run on any page; Playwright-crawl all pages at 400/1920/3440 into a jsonl log; hunt every bad layout ranked worst-first with proposed fixes; build a layout library + bad-layout don'ts in LayoutTool; sync knowledge base with layout-design skill.
steps: Rule fixes from crawl evidence (Opus E)

links.label: Crawl v1 — the evidence that indicted the rules

set.outcome: **layout-hunt landed** — the devbar now scores any page you're viewing; the analyzer was indicted by its own crawl (4 false-positive classes authored the old ranking) and fixed; the site re-measured honestly (median 66→79, settle-aware); the audit is ranked worst-first and vision-verified: ONE declaration (styles.css:119) owns 13 of the worst 20, panels have no floor, and 3 A-grades are visibly broken (the tool can't yet see 'wrong'). Library (11 patterns) + don'ts (10 traps) shipped inside LayoutTool, live-measured, synced with the layout-design skill. 143 dead urls censused with the emitting bugs named. Six Opus agents, ~1.46M agent tokens; all fixes are PROPOSALS in audit.md per the ask — nothing applied to site CSS.
